verse.verse_3: Verily We have sent it down on a blessed night, verily We were to become warners.
verse.verse_4: Therein is decreed every affair of wisdom
verse.verse_5: As a command from before Us. Verily We were to become senders:
verse.verse_6: A mercy from thy Lord. Verily He! He is the Hearer, the Knower.
verse.verse_7: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is in- between the twain, if only ye would be convinced.
verse.verse_8: There is no god but He. He quickeneth and causeth to die: your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
verse.verse_10: So wait thou day whereon the heaven will bring forth a manifest smoke:
verse.verse_11: Covering the people's this shall be a torment afflictive.
verse.verse_12: Our Lord! remove from us the torment, verily we shall become believers.
verse.verse_13: How can there be an admonition Unto them, when surely there came Unto them an apostle manifest!
verse.verse_14: Yet they turned away from him and said: one tutored, one distraced.
verse.verse_15: Verily We shall remove the torment for a while; but verily ye shall revert.
verse.verse_16: On the Day whereon We assault them with the greatest assault, verily We shall take vengeance.
verse.verse_17: And assuredly afore them We proved Fir'awn's people, and there came Unto them an apostle honoured.
verse.verse_18: Saying: restore to me the bondmen of Allah, verily I am Unto you an apostle trusted.
verse.verse_19: And saying exalt not yourselves against Allah; verily I have come Unto you with an authority manifest.
verse.verse_20: And verily I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me.
verse.verse_21: And if ye will not believe in me, then let me alone.
verse.verse_22: Then he called upon his Lord. these are a people guilty.
verse.verse_23: So depart thou with My bondmen by night; verily ye shall be pursued.
verse.verse_24: And leave thou the sea divided: verily they are a host to be drowned.
verse.verse_25: They left - how many! - of gardens and springs.
verse.verse_27: And the delights which they had been enjoying!
verse.verse_28: Even so And We caused to inherit them another people.
verse.verse_29: And the heavens and the earth wept not over them, nor were they respited.
verse.verse_30: And assuredly We delivered the Children of Isra'il from an ignominous torment
verse.verse_31: From Fir'awn; verily he was haughty and of the extravagant.
verse.verse_32: And assuredly We elected them with knowledge above the worlds.
verse.verse_33: And We vouchsafed Unto them signs wherein was a manifest favour.
verse.verse_35: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
verse.verse_36: Bring then our fathers if ye say so.
verse.verse_37: Are they better Or the people of Tubba and those afore them? We destroyed them; verily they were culprits.
verse.verse_38: And We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is in-between the twain sporting.
verse.verse_39: We created them not save with a purpose but most of them know not.
verse.verse_40: Verily the Day of Distinction is the term appointed for all of them.
verse.verse_41: A Day whereon a friend shall not avail a friend at all, nor shall they be helped.
verse.verse_42: Save those on whom Allah will have mercy. Verily He! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
verse.verse_45: Like the dregs of all! It shall seethe in the bellies:
verse.verse_46: As the seething of boiling water.
verse.verse_47: Lay hold of him, and drag him Unto the midst of the Flaming Fire.
verse.verse_48: Then pour upon his head the torment of balling water.
verse.verse_49: Taste thou! thou art indeed mighty, honoured!
verse.verse_50: Verily this is that whereof ye were wont to doubt.
verse.verse_51: Verily the God-fearing will be in a place secure
verse.verse_53: Attired in fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
verse.verse_54: Even so. And We shall pair them with fair damsels large- eyed.
verse.verse_55: They will call therein for every kind of fruit in security.
verse.verse_56: They will not taste death therein, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the torment of the Flaming Fire.
verse.verse_57: A bounty from thy Lord. That! that is the supreme achievement.
verse.verse_58: And We have made it easy in thy language; they might haply be admonished.
verse.verse_59: Wait thou then; verily they also are waiting.
